# Private pilot order ledger — blank template

Copy this template to a private merchant-controlled location. Do not enter real order/customer data into the tracked repository. Store addresses in Stripe/Printful rather than duplicating them here. Give one person responsibility for updating and checking the ledger before each supplier purchase.

One paid customer order = one unique Stripe PaymentIntent. Multiple line items or supplier shipments do not create additional customer orders. Keep refunded orders visible. Test/sample orders do not count toward the demand milestone.

Before purchasing: live captured payment checked; no refund/hold; reference not already submitted; exact templates/artwork/size/finish/quantities/address checked; landed cost approved. Record the supplier reference immediately after submission. After an ambiguous response, look up the previous order rather than create another.

At review: gross paid customer orders ___; refunded orders ___; delivered orders ___; outstanding cases ___; actual contribution after product/shipping/payment costs and refunds ___; new checkout sessions paused ___; outstanding Stripe sessions reconciled/expired ___; Shopify automation decision ___; owner/date ___.
